notes: The board starts telling you what is connected. v0.45 gave cards links; this makes them visible on the columns you already read. A card that nothing else can start before you finish it now says 'unblocks 2' - that is your leverage, and it is the clearest 'do this one first' signal Stasys has ever had. A card something is holding up says 'waits on #250', naming the blocker, and it clears itself the moment that blocker goes Done, so there is nothing to tidy up afterwards. The first card on the table that nothing live is holding up is marked 'next'. Every linked card carries a small chain count, and opening a card now lists its lineage in both directions - what it says about others, and what others say about it, which nothing else on the board could show you. Cards touched recently read slightly brighter and long-untouched ones slightly dimmer, but a card with no date at all looks perfectly ordinary: these dates only began in v0.45, and fading a whole board's history would be a lie. Stasys also now points out four kinds of contradiction on the red strip: cards that block each other in a ring, a finished card whose blocker never finished, a link to a card that is gone, and a table where a card sits above the very thing blocking it. It warns and changes nothing - your table order is yours, and Stasys never reorders it for you.
